subject: Mutual Action Plan check-in — missed checkpoint & reprioritization
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gomes <aisha.gomes@junohealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-21T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan check-in — missed checkpoint & reprioritization

Hi Aisha,

I noticed we missed the MAP checkpoint that was scheduled for today at 11:00am PT. I hope everything is okay on your side — no problem if something ran long. Given that we weren't able to sync, I wanted to:  

- Propose a short rebook so we can align on a tightened timeline; looks like the pilot timeline has shifted on your side.
- Share an updated MAP draft (attached as Juno_MAP_v1.xlsx) with an initial reprioritization so we can accelerate the items you care most about.

High-level proposal: move the integration checkpoint out by ~2 weeks and focus first on the data ingestion + inference validation sprint. If that still sounds right, I can circulate a revised MAP and a new meeting invite.

Availability for a 30-minute catch-up this week: Thu 10:30–11:00am PT or Fri 9:00–10:00am PT. Please let me know what works and who from your team will join.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Juno_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Aisha Gomes <aisha.gomes@junohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@junohealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan check-in — missed checkpoint & reprioritization

Marissa —

So sorry about the no-show. Our clinical town hall ran over by an hour and the rest of the leadership was pulled into an emergency vendor review. I'm really sorry for the disruption.

We do need to shift the pilot timeline: the CISO team requested an additional procurement step and our clinical ops asked for a separate validation window for the inference outputs. That effectively pushes our internal readiness by ~2 weeks, so your reprioritization sounds aligned.

I can do Thu 10:30am PT for a short call but Tom (clinical ops) will only be available Fri morning; would you be able to do Thu 10:30 and then a follow-up with Tom on Fri if needed?

We'll also attach the updated stakeholder list and procurement intake in a follow-up note.

Apologies again for the scramble — want to make sure we get the right people on the MAP decisions.

Best,
Aisha
Head of Partnerships, Juno Health
aisha.gomes@junohealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gomes <aisha.gomes@junohealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-21T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan check-in — missed checkpoint & reprioritization

Thanks for the quick update, Aisha — understood. Thu 10:30am PT works for me for the first sync; we can schedule a 15–30min follow-up with Tom on Fri if he needs to walk through the clinical validation items.

I've attached an updated MAP (Juno_MAP_v2.xlsx) that:  
- Marks integration & inference validation as Priority 1, target start week of 2027-05-03
- Moves pilot go/no-go decision to 2027-06-07 (tentative)
- Adds a procurement milestone (Procurement intake complete) before credentials & onboarding

Action items before Thu 10:30am PT:  
- Aisha: confirm attendees for Thu + who will own procurement milestone (Tom or Procurement).
- Tom (if on Fri): confirm clinical validation acceptance criteria (we drafted suggested criteria in the MAP).
- Rishi/Priyom (Redwood): I'll come prepared with a short demo of the ingestion flow and a one-slide cost/latency tradeoff summary.

Proposed calendar invite attached (calendar-invite.ics). If Thu 10:30 PT works, I'll send the invite now. Also linking the MAP draft here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleJunoMAP

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachments: Juno_MAP_v2.xlsx, calendar-invite.ics
From: Aisha Gomes <aisha.gomes@junohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@junohealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan check-in — missed checkpoint & reprioritization

Marissa —

Confirming Thu 10:30am PT works. Attendees: Aisha (me), Tom Nguyen (Clinical Ops), and Priya Shah (Procurement). Tom will not be on Thu for the deep acceptance criteria discussion, but he can join Fri for the 15–20 minute follow-up you proposed.

We reviewed the MAP and the priority changes look good. Procurement will take ownership of the procurement milestone (Priya). We'll also upload the procurement intake doc and the SOC2 summary to the drive link before the Thu call.

Thanks for pulling this together. See you Thu.

—Aisha

Perfect — thanks Aisha. Invite sent for Thu 10:30am PT (30 minutes). Agenda for the call:  

1) Quick 5-min status: what changed in your timeline and ownership
2) 10-min demo: ingestion -> inference flow + key telemetry we capture
3) 10-min MAP alignment: confirm priority 1 milestones, procurement owner, and next follow-up cadence

Pre-call deliverables:  
- Juno: procurement intake doc + SOC2 summary uploaded to the Drive link (thanks).
- Redwood: short cost/latency one-slide + Juno_MAP_v2.xlsx (attached).

I'll also create two follow-up time options for Fri in case Tom wants a short sync — will send a separate 15-minute hold. HubSpot: HS-987654 has been updated with the new MAP and proposed dates.

See you Thu —
